description: Execute deterministic manager-worker deep research with locked roles, append-only journals, serial reduction, and evidence/prose gates.
use_when: you need auditable multi-agent research that can be reproduced end to end
title: Deep Research Agent
summary: Run a deterministic deep-research workflow that separates manager planning from worker evidence collection and enforces binary publication gates.
primary_use_cases: Run manager-worker research with immutable role contracts.
Generate canonical evidence from append-only worker journals.
Gate report delivery on citation integrity and prose quality.

workflow_steps.title: Preflight and brief lock
workflow_steps.purpose: Freeze objective, question set, and tie-break rules before worker execution.
actions: Create run artifact root and required subdirectories.
Write brief, question set, and decision rules with deterministic fields.
Require explicit user approval before worker execution.

workflow_steps.title: Manager plan and role lockfile
workflow_steps.purpose: Assign worker responsibilities and freeze immutable role contracts.
actions: Build manager role lockfile with contiguous worker IDs and domain boundaries.
Compile per-worker locks with deterministic hashes and validate each lock.
Freeze role lock artifacts for the run.

workflow_steps.title: Worker execution and journaling
workflow_steps.purpose: Capture evidence through append-only worker journals.
actions: Append journal events via `worker_journal_append.py` only.
Record source metadata in NDJSON with journal traceability.
Mark worker completion with terminal status events.

workflow_steps.title: Serial reducer merge
workflow_steps.purpose: Merge worker journals into canonical evidence in deterministic order.
workflow_steps.when: Run after all workers are complete.
actions: Run reducer merge in one serial process.
Generate canonical evidence with stable claim IDs.
Record unresolved conflicts without deletion.

workflow_steps.title: Citation and validation gates
workflow_steps.purpose: Enforce evidence integrity before prose drafting.
actions: Evaluate citation validation gate rules.
Block delivery when any citation gate fails.
Route failures to remediation and rerun worker/reducer steps as needed.

workflow_steps.title: Prose quality gate
workflow_steps.purpose: Score narrative quality and enforce threshold pass/fail.
actions: Draft report from canonical evidence only.
Run prose rubric scoring with deterministic thresholds.
Revise wording and rerun until gate passes.

workflow_steps.title: Delivery and handoff
workflow_steps.purpose: Publish an auditable package with gate outcomes and decisions.
actions: Verify required artifacts and lock checksums.
Assemble handoff with findings, risks, and recommendations.
Mark run completion with status artifact.

reference_docs.title: Step 0 Workflow: Preflight and brief lock
reference_docs.objective: Freeze brief and decision context before worker execution.

reference_docs.title: Step 1 Workflow: Manager plan and role lockfile
reference_docs.objective: Build immutable role plans and worker lock contracts.

reference_docs.title: Step 2 Workflow: Worker execution and journaling
reference_docs.objective: Capture worker evidence in append-only journals.
required_actions: Append events with deterministic hash chain.
done_when: Status board has no blocked workers.

reference_docs.title: Step 3 Workflow: Serial reducer merge
reference_docs.objective: Create canonical evidence from worker journals deterministically.
done_when: Merge log and conflicts are complete.

reference_docs.title: Step 4 Workflow: Citation and validation gates
reference_docs.objective: Enforce evidence integrity before prose drafting.

reference_docs.title: Step 5 Workflow: Prose quality gate
reference_docs.objective: Enforce narrative quality with deterministic scoring.
done_when: Prose quality report status is PASS.

reference_docs.title: Validation Gate
reference_docs.objective: Define binary pass/fail rules for citation and prose gates.
required_actions: Evaluate prose rules P1-P6 after citation pass.
done_when: Validation report is emitted with PASS or FAIL and corrective actions.
